name: 沙面岛
description: 广州沙面历史街区，百年欧式建筑群沿江而建，拱门与柱廊在阳光下投下斑驳光影。
descriptionEn: Historic Shamian district in Guangzhou — century-old European buildings along the Pearl River, with arched doorways and colonnades casting dappled shadows.

name: 春日花园
description: 一个精心打理的欧式花园，阳光透过树叶洒在草地上。
descriptionEn: A beautifully maintained European garden bathed in dappled sunlight.

name: 花园漫步
description: 深入探索花园的每一个角落，感受更丰富的细节层次。
descriptionEn: Explore every corner of the garden with richer detail.
